_readme: Reviews shown on the site. refresh-reviews.php (monthly cron on Hostinger) updates google.rating, google.count and adds new Google reviews; tools/scrape-google-reviews.py does the same from a PC.
featured = which review ids each page shows, in order. excerpt = shortened quote (use … for cuts, never change words). role = what the event was, shown after the name.
The pages contain a static copy of the featured quotes (run py tools/render-reviews.py after editing this file); site.js replaces it with this file's contents when the page loads.

reviews.name: GCM
reviews.text: We hired Reagan to sing at our Annual Meals on Wheels Valentine's Gala this past February. He brought a smooth, warm, and classy feel to the atmosphere, which was perfect for the evening as we wanted a romantic and intimate environment. When planning events, we always try to find live, local talent to service our events, and Reagan delivered! We selected songs from a list he provided, which included a wide variety of style and genre, yet his own personal style blended them all together effortlessly. We got many compliments on the music, and Reagan was a joy to work with! Highly recommend for any occasion.

Also had all of his own gear to bring to the event which was super helpful since we did not have that equipment. Cannot recommend him enough!

reviews.name: Katherine Holtzman
reviews.text: We hired Reagan for our ceremony and wedding cocktail hour. He was great to work with: very responsive and well prepared. Because he played for both parts of the event there were some subtle details such as cues for switching from fully acoustic ceremony music to more lively cocktail music and Reagan proactively worked with us to develop a plan for a seamless transition. His music was a wonderful addition to our event!

reviews.name: Philip & Adelia Hodge
reviews.text: What a talented artist Reagan Leonard is!!! We were able to book Reagan for my sons engagement party and he did not disappoint! He provided a list of songs which we were able to choose from to create a very customized playlist. He has an incredible voice that he accompanies with superb guitar playing. Reagan was very professional and played for 3 hours straight without taking a break. We had a steady stream of wonderful music. If we were having the wedding in Greenville, I would definitely book Reagan again!

reviews.text: Reagan was a perfect fit for our wedding ceremony and cocktail hour! He learned a new song for our ceremony and played it beautifully. Our guests loved him!

reviews.name: Kitty Gordon
reviews.text: Reagan played at my daughter's bridal shower at City Scape Winery in Greenville and he created a perfect ambiance for a beautiful afternoon! Reagan was very responsive so we could discuss the details and what we were hoping to achieve which made the planning very easy. He has a great range of songs and played exactly what we were looking for. It was a perfect afternoon and Reagan was a big part of why! I highly recommend him!

reviews.text: Reagan was great for our corporate event! He was so easy to work with, was prompt, and so friendly! Everyone was impressed by his range and it suited our event so well. I wouldn’t skip out on using him for your next event!

reviews.name: Greg and Rebecca Pilette
reviews.text: I contacted Reagan and used him for a Welcome/Rehearsal Dinner prior to our son’s wedding. We live out of state so I researched and listened to some of his videos. We were thrilled when he was available! His music is beautiful and was a perfect fit for our event. He is extremely polite and professional and was so obliging when asked to use his microphone for toasting. I cannot be more pleased with Reagan and his performance, it truly enhanced our special occasion. He is a very talented musician and an extremely nice gentleman. I highly recommend him!!!
